title: HuggingFace Token (Secret, Textable)
description: Bearer token for the HuggingFace Hub API.
documentation:
## Purpose
Carries a HuggingFace Hub bearer token between caps. The token is forwarded as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to the HuggingFace API for the call's duration only — no implicit fallback to the `HF_TOKEN` environment variable, no global state.

## When to use
Use this media type for any cap argument that must reach gated HuggingFace repositories (license-protected models such as the `gemma-*` family). Caps that do not provide a token to a gated download fail hard with a clear authentication error.

## Notes
- The `secret` tag instructs UIs and logs to mask the value.
- An empty string is treated as "no token". Pass a non-empty string to authenticate.

## Security
Security tags annotate values with handling requirements. Values tagged `secret`
are treated as confidential — log redaction, masked display, and secure-channel
transport apply automatically.

Sensitive credential or key material. Must not appear in logs or display surfaces
in cleartext. Transmitted only over secure channels.

## Textable
Coercion marker indicating the value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text.
Strings are textable trivially; integers and booleans are textable via their
string form; structured values are textable when JSON-serialised. Binary blobs
(images, audio, raw bytes) are NOT textable — converting them to text requires
explicit transformation that may be lossy.

The value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text without loss.
